title: Sales Administrator
description:
Sales Administrator
- Location - Liverpool
- Salary - 27,000 - 30,000
- Contract - 12 month fixed term contract
- Hours - Full time, Monday to Friday, 8:45 - 5pm

Your new company

My client is looking for a dynamic and experienced Sales Administrator to join their busy and fast paced team due to growth. This is an exciting opportunity to become a part of an experienced team within an international organisation.

The role will be on offered on an initial 12 month fixed term contract.

Your new role
The main purpose of your role is to manage sales orders from receipt to delivery whilst ensuring excellent customer service is delivered at all times.

Key duties will include:
- Handling customer queries
- Managing order processing
- Liaising with Sales Managers and communicating with other internal departments.
- You will also be expected to complete any other ad-hoc administration tasks as well as building relationships and keeping up to date with any new product information.

What you'll need to succeed
- You must have previous experience processing orders and managing customer accounts.
- Relationship building and client care is key for this role so you will be able to demonstrate this in a previous position.
- You will be self motivated and be able to use your own initiative as well as being systems savvy and able to pick up new systems quickly.

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age

title: Credit Controller
description:
As a Credit Controller based in St Helen's, you'll play a key role in managing customer accounts and ensuring timely payments. This is a 12 week contract to help support.

Client Details

Our client is an established business in St Helen's, they are looking for an experienced Credit Controller for 12 weeks to help support out with key accounts and high-volume backlog.

Description

The Credit Controller duties include:
- Manage and monitor customer accounts to ensure timely payments.
- Contact customers to follow up on overdue invoices and resolve payment delays.
- Reconcile accounts and investigate discrepancies.
- Prepare and maintain accurate records of all credit control activities.
- Work closely with internal teams to address and resolve queries related to accounts.
- Provide regular updates on outstanding debts and escalate issues where necessary.
- Contribute to improving processes to enhance efficiency in credit control.

Profile

A successful Credit Controller should have:
- Previous experience in a credit control or similar accounting role.
- Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.
- Good communication skills for liaising with customers and internal teams.
- The ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
- Knowledge of accounting systems and proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

Job Offer

The benefits include:
- An hourly rate of 32-33k, weekly pay via Michael Page (including holidays)
- Full-time office
- Parking

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: School Attendance Administrator
description:
School Attendance Administrator - St Helens

Location: St Helens, Merseyside
Working Pattern: Monday to Friday, 5 days per week
Hours: 8:00am-4:00pm or 9:00am-5:00pm
Start Date: To be confirmed
Contract: School-based temporary vacancy
Pay: Competitive rates, dependent on experience

Tradewind Recruitment is currently recruiting for a School Attendance Administrator to join a secondary school in St Helens. This is a genuine vacancy for an organised, reliable and professional administrator who can support the school's attendance processes and contribute to the smooth running of its administrative operations.

The school requires someone who can work confidently with attendance information, communicate effectively with parents and staff, and maintain accurate records in a busy secondary school environment.

This position is available five days per week, with working hours of either 8:00am-4:00pm or 9:00am-5:00pm.

The Role

As a School Attendance Administrator, you will play an important part in supporting the school's attendance procedures, helping ensure that pupil absences are accurately recorded and followed up.

Responsibilities are expected to include:
- Monitoring and updating daily pupil attendance records
- Recording absences, late arrivals and attendance information
- Contacting parents and carers regarding unexplained absences
- Maintaining accurate information on the school's management information system
- Supporting attendance officers and pastoral colleagues
- Producing attendance reports and administrative records
- Responding professionally to telephone and email enquiries
- Handling confidential pupil and family information appropriately
- Supporting general school administration where required

The successful candidate will need to demonstrate accuracy, discretion and confidence when communicating with pupils, parents and colleagues.

The Ideal Candidate

We are particularly interested in applicants who have:
- Previous school administration or attendance administration experience
- Experience using school management information systems, such as SIMS, Arbor or Bromcom
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
- Confident telephone and written communication skills
- The ability to manage competing administrative priorities
- An understanding of confidentiality and data protection
- A professional and approachable manner
- The ability to work effectively within a busy school office

Previous experience in a school attendance role would be particularly advantageous.

Candidates with strong administrative backgrounds outside education may also be considered where their experience is relevant.

Why Work with Tradewind Recruitment?

Working through Tradewind Recruitment provides:
- Competitive rates of pay
- Weekly pay
- A dedicated education recruitment consultant
- Access to school administration opportunities across St Helens and surrounding areas
- Free CPD through The National College
- Support throughout the recruitment and registration process
- Ongoing support during your placement

Important Applicant Information

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK and be able to commute reliably to St Helens.

The successful candidate will be subject to appropriate safeguarding checks, including an enhanced DBS check and satisfactory references.

Apply Today

If you are an experienced School Attendance Administrator, Attendance Officer or School Administrator looking for your next opportunity in St Helens, we'd be keen to hear from you.

Apply today or contact Anthony Bailey at Tradewind Recruitment to discuss this vacancy.

Anthony Bailey
Tradewind Recruitment
